title: TopoMarket v1.2 - frozen structure, blind replay and experimental evidence

scenes.picture: Social preview opening card with product claim and exact repository URL
scenes.narration: TopoMarket maps market structure and tests whether topology can warn of sharp declines.

scenes.picture: Guided tour first stop: frozen retrospective 2008-08-29 29/66 (mean r 0.791) -> 2008-10-10 66/66 (mean r 0.911), +37/0, retrospective label, r >= 0.80 cutoff
scenes.narration: Frozen retrospective: 29 of 66 pairs on 2008-08-29; 66 of 66 on 2008-10-10. Mean correlation rises from 0.791 to 0.911.

scenes.picture: Finance selected in the interactive network, then Mapper groups overlap view with shared-portfolio edge widths
scenes.narration: Finance: eleven qualifying pairs. Mapper groups portfolios by shared structure.

scenes.picture: 2025-03-10 late-warning teaching example (outside the frozen evaluation): percentile 100, frozen threshold 100, Takens window and H1 persistence diagram
scenes.narration: March 10, 2025: a late-warning teaching example at percentile 100. Takens and H1 show the S&P 500 return shape; the frozen threshold is 100.

scenes.picture: Blind Replay with no outcome, then explicit reveal: origin 305.998, boundary 275.398, lowest 299.830, maximum decline 2.02%, no 10% breach
scenes.narration: Blind replay. Reveal: the index stayed above the 10% boundary, with a 2.02% maximum decline.

scenes.picture: Validation evidence cards and three-method chart: TDA 0/3 (AP 0.0154), VIX 1/3 (AP 0.1187), experimental wording and limitations
scenes.narration: Experimental: TDA 0 of 3, VIX 1 of 3. Average precision is low.

scenes.picture: Static end card holding github.com/SergeyGer/TopoMarket for five seconds
scenes.narration: Explore the code and the live demo on GitHub.

recorded_from: identical local v1.2.0 build; public deployment smoke-verified on 1.2.0
